text:
harper: Quick follow-up from the midnight postmortem. We split remediation into three owners: quota guard, eviction attenuation, and runway tooling. Need owners and acceptance tests so these don't go stale.

mike: I'll take quota guard. Proposal: soft reserve of 11% for interactive pools, alert at 86% sustained 5m, pager at 93% sustained 3m. Add spill-to-delay-queue instead of hard rejection. ETA 6 business days.

rina: I'll own eviction attenuation (scheduler tuning). Plan: reduce packing aggressiveness for background jobs and add a 25s damp window after eviction. New score to try: `score = mem_frac*1.45 + cpu_frac*0.65 + age_secs*0.0009`. Will run a 7-day trace sim and share p50/p95/p99 + cost delta.

harper: metrics-bot, can you add predicted_runway_minutes (linear) and expose pool.reserved_pct and pool.avg_mem_frac(1m) so the new ops card can run?

metrics-bot: Added metrics: pool.reserved_pct, pool.active_gpu_jobs, pool.avg_mem_frac_{1m,5m}. Linear predicted_runway_minutes available as synthetic metric. Links: https://redwood.internal/metrics#1779991234

mike: acceptance test for quota guard:

```
# acceptance
ramp(batch_qps=3.5x, duration=900s)
assert(reserved_pct(interactive) >= 11%)
expect(alert='quota_soft', within=120s)
expect(pager='quota_hard', if=sustained(>93%, 180s))
```

rina: scheduler sim snippet: 

```
# sim
trace_replay(days=7)
apply_config(evict_damp_ms=25000, eviction_score='mem_frac*1.45 + cpu_frac*0.65 + age_secs*0.0009')
measure(p50,p95,p99,pack_latency,token_cost)
```

harper: ops card: show linear runway (1h) + model column (alpha). If linear runway < 30m AND growth_rate > 4%/m then trigger preemptive scale + page (15m cooldown). Start with linear only.

mike: I'll implement spill-to-delay-queue in control plane and add CI acceptance test. Also add an acceptance case: ensure interactive tail-latency < 200ms during spike.

metrics-bot: Created remediation items: G-7701 (quota-guard), G-7702 (eviction-attenuation), G-7703 (runway-card). Assigned owners: mike, rina, harper. Due dates: 2024-07-20, 2024-07-18, 2024-07-16.

rina: blocker: need historical per-job mem_frac histograms (30d) to tune eviction weight. @infra-sre can you backfill?

harper: infra-sre pinged — we need the API field desired_headroom_pct on /pools/:id to show targets in ops.

metrics-bot: Backfill job scheduled; ETA 4h. API PR for desired_headroom_pct requested.

mike: ownership recap: mike -> G-7701 (quota guard + tests), rina -> G-7702 (scheduler tuning + sims), harper -> G-7703 (runway metrics + ops card). I'll add these to the postmortem follow-ups doc and schedule a 72h check-in.

harper: also adding a recurring checklist for 3 weeks: "weekly headroom trend" assigned to SRE Mondays to catch slow regressions.

rina: will post sim numbers in 48h and include p50/p95/p99 and token-cost delta.

mike: thanks team. If anything slips, escalate in this thread. :white_check_mark:
